instruction.text: Listen to the poem and select the words that rhyme.

atoms.b:
Have you seen anything so ((nice)),
like an acrobat troupe of ((mice))?
atoms.sound: Have you seen anything so nice....like an acrobat troupe of mice?

atoms.b:
They hop, leap, jump and ((fly)),
twirling high up in the ((sky)).
atoms.sound: They hop, leap, jump and fly...twirling high up in the sky.

atoms.b:
Their tails curl above them while they ((dance)).
Did you hear they come from ((France))?
atoms.sound: Their tails curl above them while they dance...Did you hear they come from France?
The show was divine...they really did shine.
